Published: September 3, 2026

Attackers abused the PHP2Shell flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, against unpatched servers.

Researchers published proof-of-concept code for CVE-2026-109619 shortly after the disclosure.

The News Kit Addons for Elementor flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-97353 and was patched in version 1.4.2.

The Elementor Pro Widget Pack flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-97354 and is a separate issue.
